subject: Introduction and Opportunity to Connect
context: Cold introduction to a senior external contact (Melody), warm-referred through family.
author: Yancey Dawson
body:
Melody, I hope your New Year is off to a great start.
I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself. My name is Yancey Dawson, and I am a consultant with Upperform. I have been supporting NiSource for approximately four years across several initiatives, including Work Management, Pigging Operations, and NIPSCO Electric Operations, among others.
By background, I am an electrical engineer originally from Louisiana. During a recent visit to New Orleans, both of my uncles Charles and Terrance Rice spoke very highly of you and mentioned that they know you well. Terrance also shared that you are an avid fisherman. I share that interest, along with golf.
If you would be open to it, I would welcome the opportunity to connect the next time I am in Columbus. I would be happy to coordinate with your executive assistant to see if our schedules align for a lunch meeting and a brief formal introduction.
It is a pleasure to finally reach out. I have heard many positive things about you and wanted to personally introduce myself and say hello.

Warm regards,
Yancey Dawson
Upperform Consulting
